blocks.text: Entropy ka concept (khayal) Rudolph Clausius ne 1856 mein thermodynamics mein shamil kiya, taake doosre law ko quantitative (hisab wali) basis (jar) mile. Yeh pressure, volume, temperature aur internal energy ke saath system ki halat batane wala ek aur variable hai. Agar system reversible process mein absolute temperature T par heat ΔQ absorb (andar le lena) kare, to us ki entropy S naam ki state variable mein increase (barhna) yeh hai:
Potential energy aur internal energy ki tarah entropy mein bhi us ki change (ΔS) aham hai.

System ko heat di jaye to entropy ki change positive, aur heat nikali jaye to negative hoti hai. Maan lein heat Q temperature T₁ wale reservoir se ek conducting rod ke zariye temperature T₂ wale reservoir tak jati hai, aur T₁ > T₂. Heat khone wale T₁ reservoir ki entropy Q/T₁ kam hoti hai aur heat pane wale T₂ reservoir ki entropy Q/T₂ barhti hai. Chunke T₁ > T₂, is liye Q/T₂ bara hai Q/T₁ se, yani Q/T₂ > Q/T₁.
Is liye entropy ki net change (Q/T₂ − Q/T₁) positive hai.

Is se result nikalta hai ke har natural (khud ba khud hone wala) process mein, jahan heat ek system se doosre mein jaye, entropy hamesha net barhti hai. Yeh thermodynamics ke doosre law ka ek aur bayan hai:

blocks.title: Entropy ki shakal mein doosra law
blocks.text: Agar system koi natural process kare, to woh usi direction (rukh) mein chalega jis se system aur surroundings (aas paas ki cheezein) ki total (kul) entropy barhe.

Dekha gaya hai ke natural process zyada disorder (bikhrao) ki taraf jata hai. Is liye entropy aur molecules ki disorder ka rishta hai. Misal: garam se thandi cheez ki taraf heat ka irreversible flow (behna) disorder barhata hai, kyun ke shuru mein molecules garam aur thande hisson mein alag alag tarteeb se the; system ke thermal equilibrium mein aane par yeh tarteeb khatam ho jati hai. System ko heat dene se molecules ki average (darmiyani value) speed barhti hai, is liye un ki motion (chalna ya hilna) zyada random (bina kisi tarteeb ke) ho jati hai. Isi tarah gas ka free expansion (khula phailao) disorder barhata hai, kyun ke phailne ke baad molecules ki jagah pehle se zyada random hoti hai. Dono misalon mein entropy barh jati hai.

Is se result yeh hai ke sirf woh processes ho sakte hain jin mein system ki entropy barhe ya utni hi rahe. Jis process mein entropy constant rahe woh reversible hai; har irreversible process mein system ki entropy barhti hai.

Har baar entropy barhne par kuch heat ko work mein badalne ka mauqa kho jata hai. Misal: garam aur thanda pani milane se entropy barhti hai, aur phir neem garam pani ko dobara garam aur thandi layers (tehon) mein alag nahi kiya ja sakta. Energy lost (zaya) nahi hui, magar kuch energy ab work mein nahi badal sakti. Is liye entropy barhne ka matlab energy ka degradation (darja girna) hai: oonche darje se, jahan zyada work nikal sakta hai, neeche darje tak, jahan kam ya bilkul work nahi nikalta. Energy zyada tarteeb wali shakal se kam tarteeb wali shakal mein jati hai aur aakhir thermal energy ban jati hai.

Har asal process mein jahan heat ka len den ho, useful (faidemand) work ke liye milne wali energy kam hoti hai; yani entropy barhti hai. Agar kisi system ka temperature kam ho kar us ki entropy ghate bhi, to kisi doosre system ki entropy us se zyada barhti hai. Saare systems ko mila kar universe (saari duniya aur aasman) samjhein to universe ki entropy hamesha barhti hai.

blocks.title: Example 6.5
blocks.problem: 0 °C par 1.0 kg barf pighal kar 0 °C ka pani banti hai. Entropy ki change nikalein. Barf ki latent heat of fusion L_f = 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹.
steps: ΔS = ΔQ/T, aur pighalne ki heat ΔQ = mL_f, is liye ΔS = mL_f/T
blocks.answer: Barf ke pani banne par entropy 1.23 × 10³ J K⁻¹ barhti hai. Yeh increase batata hai ke solid se liquid bante hue pani ke molecules kitne zyada random ho gaye.

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Taash ki gaddi phentne (shuffle) par zyada random kyun ho jati hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser: taash ki gaddi phentne par zyada random kyun ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Taash ke patton ko tarteeb se rakhne ke tareeqe bohat kam hain, aur random rakhne ke tareeqe bohat hi zyada. Phentna patton ko andha-dhund (random) badalta hai, is liye taqreeban hamesha koi random halat hi aati hai. Yahi entropy ka khayal hai: natural process zyada disorder ki taraf jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 0 °C par 1.0 mole barf (18 g) pighalne par entropy ki change nikalein.

items: Entropy (Clausius, 1856): ΔS = ΔQ/T, state variable; heat andar ho to +, bahar jaye to −.
T₁ se T₂ (T₁ > T₂) tak heat Q: net change Q/T₂ − Q/T₁ positive; natural process system + surroundings ki entropy barhata hai (doosra law); sirf reversible process mein constant.
Entropy disorder ka naap hai; is ka barhna energy ka darja girata hai; universe ki entropy hamesha barhti hai. Example 6.5: 1 kg barf pighalne par ΔS = 1.23 × 10³ J K⁻¹.
